title: Love the potential
body: I love the idea of the app but it’s hard to use quickly to meal plan for the next week. I can’t select meals for multiple days. I like the grocery list tab. The recipes turn out great!

title: Printing
body: Still learning my way around but so far, very favorable. But, how can I print a recipe from the app?

title: Great app!
body: I love how organized the app is, it’s so easy to find my recipes. I’m loving it so far

title: Cookbook
body: 10/10 recommend had the cookbook before the app came out now it’s 10x easier with more things!

title: Just started using
body: I just started using but I like how many options of meals there are, it’s easy to upload recipes and save in the app and I like how quickly the app can give me a nutrition estimate. so far I’ve been able to plan this weeks breakfast and dinner to make my day easier.

title: Super easy to use and find saved recipes
body: I love how easy it is to view a recipe, plus the ability to easily double the quantities makes this way more useful . The pictures are beautiful and clear. Must try this app

title: Jas’ Recipe Cookbook
body: I bought a cookbook from Jas a few months ago and have been loving using the recipes. The app however makes it so much better! It having the ingredients and it calculating serving sizes based on how much you want is so helpful. I found myself at times counting it myself and it was sometimes difficult but it’s so much easier now. Also it showing the grocery list on its own is so user-friendly. I was creating my own list in my notes while flipping back to the PDF and it was a mess lol love it already!!

title: Favorites
body: Love the app, Hi! I’d love to request a Favorites feature for the recipes that are already built into the Daily Bite app. It would be really helpful to be able to tap a heart or favorite button on any built-in recipe and have all of those recipes collected in one Favorites section for easy access later. Right now, I’d love a simple way to save the app’s existing recipes that I know I want to make again. Thank you!
